svg.title: UI Design Languages — Nine Complete Style Packs with Real Pages, DESIGN.md and Code
svg.desc: Original editorial vector cover: bold typography on the left; on the right a three-by-three mosaic of nine interface specimens, one per design language — Clay, Lilac, Atelier, Tactile, Sketch, Braun, Obsidian, Zine and Terrarium — each drawn in its own material, type and accent.
